page.overview:
Who is Benzine girl?

The Benzine girl is an unnamed student at Springfield Elementary and Lisa's friend.

She praises the leatheroleum and smell of benzine of the year book Retrospecticus.

She is later seen in the Junior Achievers Club at Springfield Elementary School.
